payload.description: test/runner/coordination-research-fan-out.test.mjs's 'R5 concurrency: dispatchResearchFanOut fanning out to 2 branches CONCURRENTLY, maxConcurrency:1' test flakes under full-suite load (observed 3x during test-suite-feedback-cost track, 2026-09-15/16) -- the assertion 'expected the rejected branch not to wait out the in-flight executor's delay' depends on a tight wall-clock timing window that full-suite CPU contention can miss. Always passes in isolation. Needs either a wider timing margin or a non-wall-clock-dependent assertion of the same invariant.
